profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Bohol 1st District representative with 19 principal-authored bills. Authored a universal social pension for all seniors, a monthly social pension for indigent PWDs, a senior birthday cash benefit, a higher PERA for government employees, a constitutional convention call, new municipal trial courts and a Bohol electricity franchise. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Constitutional convention (HB05870) scope is unspecified and not scored, so democratic institutions is not scored. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal social pension for all seniors and a monthly pension for indigent PWDs (-3), higher PERA for government employees and a senior birthday cash benefit (-1); co-authored national minimum wage (-2). Three issues, bill-based.
